scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run deps && npm run knip && npm run docs && npm run openapi > /dev/null && npm run suppressions && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.pree2e: npm run build -w @conexus/server && npm run build -w @conexus/web && npm exec -w @conexus/web -- playwright-core install chromium-headless-shell
scripts.e2e: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=300000 --test-reporter=./scripts/test-reporter.ts tests/e2e/invitation.test.ts tests/e2e/client.test.ts tests/e2e/projects.test.ts tests/e2e/two-companies.test.ts tests/e2e/remove-person.test.ts tests/e2e/app.test.ts
